questions.qtext: What is a subspace of a vector space?

options.text: A set of linearly independent vectors
A set of vectors that spans the entire space
A subset of the vector space that is itself a vector space

questions.solution:
(c)
A subspace of a vector space is a subset of the vector space that is itself a vector space, satisfying all the properties of a vector space.

questions.qtext: When are vectors said to be linearly dependent?

options.text: When they span the entire vector space
When they are orthogonal to each other
When they can be expressed as linear combinations of each other
When they form a basis for the vector space

questions.solution:
(c)
Vectors are said to be linearly dependent if one or more of the vectors in the set can be expressed as a linear combination of the others.

questions.qtext: What is the rank of a matrix?

options.text: The number of rows in the matrix
The number of columns in the matrix
The maximum number of linearly independent rows or columns

questions.solution:
(c)
The rank of a matrix is the maximum number of linearly independent rows or columns in the matrix.

questions.qtext: Which of the following statements is true about the determinant of a matrix?

options.text: It indicates the size of the matrix
It is zero if and only if the matrix is singular
It is equal to the trace of the matrix

questions.solution:
(c)
The determinant of a matrix is zero if and only if the matrix is singular, meaning it does not have an inverse.
